source: read-only full pg_conversion raw tuples, pg_proc source symbols/signatures/flags and encoding mappings
semantic_review: Every current conversion tuple and callable metadata itemized and checked for default status, distinct encoding direction, unique pair, six-argument immutable parallel-safe non-SECURITY-DEFINER function identity. Not a test of native implementation or real encoded data.
limitations: Native C transcoding source and runtime conversions unverified
Converting from UTF-8 app does not make other built-in converters removable
